create_guardrail_instance: create an XecGuardGuardrail instance with an api_key to scan LLM requests against prompt injection and harmful content policies
apply_guardrail_pre_post_call: apply the XecGuardGuardrail apply_guardrail method to block unsafe LLM inputs or responses before or after a call
call_scan_endpoint: call the XecGuard scan endpoint to check conversation messages against configured security policies like prompt attack protection
call_grounding_endpoint: call the XecGuard grounding endpoint to validate an assistant response against supplied reference documents
configure_logging_only_mode: configure the async_logging_hook to run non-blocking XecGuard scans in logging_only mode without blocking requests
